$comment: THE error vocabulary. One home, three consumers: the Python service, the
TypeScript client (generated — see scripts/gen_error_codes.mjs), and the
It exists because there were three vocabularies and none of them agreed:
the service emitted free-text 'error' plus a separate reason field with the
values budget|unsupported|internal; the DB enum used PARSE|UNCONVERGED|
frontend branched on neither, because it could only render the free text.
A UI cannot react to a failure it cannot name, so every refusal degraded
Every entry carries what the CALLER should do, not what the implementer
saw. An error described from the implementer's point of view is not
documented. `points_at` is the working alternative when one exists — the
product's rule is that a refusal names the actor and the way forward.

NOT_FOUND and DB_UNAVAILABLE were added 2026-08-11 after the admin router found that err() could not express either: every registered code mapped to http 200/403/413, so the router hand-rolled the envelope shape instead. A vocabulary that cannot say "the database is down" forces every caller to invent its own way of saying it, which is how three vocabularies happened.

PARSE.meaning: The molecule could not be read at all.
PARSE.caller_action: Show the offending input and stop. Do not retry the same bytes.
PARSE.user_copy: This molecule could not be parsed.

UNCONVERGED.meaning: The SCF did not reach convergence, including after the second-order rescue.
UNCONVERGED.caller_action: Offer a larger budget or a different basis; never render a field from an unconverged wavefunction.
UNCONVERGED.user_copy: The wavefunction did not converge — refusing to ship a decorative field.

UNPARAMETERIZED.meaning: The empirical method has no parameters for one or more atoms (Gasteiger on hypervalent P, MMFF on B/Se, Crippen on exotics).
UNPARAMETERIZED.caller_action: Name the elements and offer the quantum path, which does not need parameters.

BUDGET.meaning: The wall-clock deadline fired, or the pre-flight cost model refused before starting.
BUDGET.caller_action: Offer max_seconds explicitly, or a smaller basis. The refusal message carries the estimate.
BUDGET.user_copy: This would take longer than the budget allows.

OPEN_SHELL_SPIN_REQUIRED.meaning: A transition metal is present whose ground state is not the closed-shell singlet that electron parity implies.
OPEN_SHELL_SPIN_REQUIRED.caller_action: Resend with an explicit spin. This is a question, not a dead end — the previous vocabulary collapsed it into UNSUPPORTED, which reads as 'give up'.
OPEN_SHELL_SPIN_REQUIRED.user_copy: This metal centre needs an explicit spin multiplicity.

UNSUPPORTED.meaning: The request is well-formed but outside what this method declares it can do (an element with no basis, an unknown field kind, a basis outside the whitelist).
UNSUPPORTED.caller_action: Read the method's capabilities and offer a supported alternative.
UNSUPPORTED.user_copy: Not supported for this molecule or these settings.

TOO_LARGE.meaning: The request body or the molecule exceeds a hard structural bound (8 MB body; V2000's 999-atom count field).
TOO_LARGE.caller_action: Reduce the selection. Retrying identical input cannot succeed.
TOO_LARGE.user_copy: Too large for this format or this endpoint.

BAD_HOST.meaning: The Host header is not one of this box's own names — the DNS-rebinding shape.
BAD_HOST.caller_action: Nothing. This is a security refusal, not a user error; do not surface it as a chemistry failure.

CANCELLED.meaning: A job was cancelled, by the user or by a worker restart.
CANCELLED.caller_action: Clear any progress UI. Offer to run it again.

INTERNAL.meaning: An unexpected exception. Nothing about the request is known to be wrong.
INTERNAL.caller_action: Show that it was our fault, not the molecule's, and keep the request so it can be retried.

NOT_FOUND.caller_action: Read the valid_routes list the response carries; an error that does not name the alternatives is a dead end.

DB_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: The database could not be reached. This is DEGRADED, not empty and not offline.
DB_UNAVAILABLE.caller_action: Say degraded, keep the compute path usable, and never render this as "there is no data" — an unreachable database and an empty queue must be visually distinguishable.
DB_UNAVAILABLE.user_copy: The database is unreachable — showing no data is not the same as there being none.

db_enum_note: app.job_error (migration 007) is a SUBSET, and the omissions are deliberate:
BAD_HOST (rejected before a job exists), OPEN_SHELL_SPIN_REQUIRED (added here
after 007 shipped), and the two ops codes NOT_FOUND / DB_UNAVAILABLE — neither
of which can ever be a job's error, because a job that failed BECAUSE the
database was unreachable has no row to record it in. That is not a gap; it is
the one error class this ledger structurally cannot hold, and saying so here is
cheaper than someone later 'fixing' the enum to match.
